![Qwen Code in the terminal, desktop app, browser, editor, and chat, with VS Code, Zed, JetBrains, Telegram, DingTalk, WeChat, and Feishu integrations](https://img.alicdn.com/imgextra/i1/O1CN01DXWdF8BDUdD3XPhl_!!6000000001721-2-tps-1743-902.png) | **Qwen Code 1.0 Preview** | | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Qwen Code 1.0 Preview brings together the agent harness capabilities of [Qoder](https://qoder.com/) and Qwen Code in an open-source release.

[Try Qwen Code 1.0 Preview](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/tree/v1.0.0-preview) · [Documentation](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/1.x/) · [中文文档](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/1.x/zh/users/overview/). | ## Why Qwen Code? - **Agentic out of the box** — Auto-Memory, Auto-Skills, SubAgents, Agent Teams, and MCP. Dynamic workflows, zero setup. - **Open-source, inside and out** — The framework and the Qwen models are open-source. They evolve together. No vendor lock-in. - **Multi-protocol** — Supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Qwen APIs. Any third-party provider or local model (Ollama / vLLM). Switch at runtime. - **Beyond the terminal** — IDE plugins, Desktop app, Web UI, SDKs, and chat integrations (Telegram / DingTalk / WeChat / Feishu). > [!TIP] > Qwen Code is actively iterating on itself — using its own agent and models to file issues, submit PRs, review code, and run tests. Powered by the community, driven by AI. ## Installation Looking for **Qwen Code 1.0 Preview**? [Get started here](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/tree/v1.0.0-preview). The instructions below are for the main version. **Linux / macOS:** ```bash curl -fsSL https://qwen-code-assets.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/installation/install-qwen-standalone.sh | bash ``` **Windows:** ```powershell irm https://qwen-code-assets.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/installation/install-qwen-standalone.ps1 | iex ``` > Restart your terminal after installation to ensure environment variables take effect.
NPM / Homebrew **NPM** (requires [Node.js 22+](https://nodejs.org/)): ```bash npm install -g @qwen-code/qwen-code@latest ``` **Homebrew** (macOS / Linux): ```bash brew install qwen-code ```
## Quick Start Open a terminal in your project and start Qwen Code: ```bash cd /path/to/your-project qwen ``` Inside the session, run `/auth` and choose [**Qwen Account with Subscription**](https://chat.qwen.ai/?memberPlan=qwen_code&entry=qwen_code&paywallScene=cli) to sign in with your **Plus or Pro subscription**, or configure a provider with an API key. Then try: ```text Explain this repository and show me where to start. ``` See the [Authentication Guide](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/configuration/auth/) and [Settings Reference](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/configuration/settings/) for detailed setup.
See the terminal interface ![Qwen Code terminal interface](https://img.alicdn.com/imgextra/i2/O1CN01K0nwj41RM1Il8kB0t_!!6000000002096-2-tps-1544-1060.png)
## How to Use Qwen Code Choose the interface that fits your workflow: | Interface | Get started | | ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **Terminal** | Run `qwen` in your project — see [Quick Start](#quick-start). | | **Desktop** | [Download Qwen Code Desktop](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/releases/tag/desktop-latest) for macOS, Windows, and Linux. | | **Web** | Run `qwen serve --open` to open the [Web UI](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/qwen-serve/) in your browser. _(experimental)_ | | **Editor** | Set up [VS Code](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/integration-vscode/), [Zed](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/integration-zed/), or [JetBrains](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/integration-jetbrains/). | | **Chat** | Connect [Telegram](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/features/channels/telegram/), [DingTalk](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/features/channels/dingtalk/), [WeChat](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/features/channels/weixin/), or [Feishu](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/features/channels/feishu/), then run `qwen channel start`. | For automation and custom integrations: - **Headless** — Run `qwen -p "..."` in scripts, CI/CD, or batch jobs. - **SDKs** — Build with [TypeScript](./packages/sdk-typescript/README.md), [Python](./packages/sdk-python/README.md), or [Java](./packages/sdk-java/qwencode/README.md). - **Daemon** — Run `qwen serve` to connect clients over HTTP + SSE (ACP). _(experimental)_ [Daemon guide](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/qwen-serve/). - **Computer Use** — Set up [native MCP tools](./packages/cua-driver/README.md#agent-integration) or [Node REPL + SDK](./packages/node-repl/README.md#usage) in Qwen Code, Claude Code, or Codex.
SDK example (Python) ```python import asyncio from qwen_code_sdk import is_sdk_result_message, query async def main() -> None: result = query( "Summarize the repository layout.", { "cwd": "/path/to/project", "path_to_qwen_executable": "qwen", }, ) async for message in result: if is_sdk_result_message(message): print(message["result"]) asyncio.run(main()) ```
## Daemon Mode Run Qwen Code as a long-lived service when you want browser, editor, SDK, and automation clients to share agent sessions without each starting a separate process. The daemon provides the built-in Web Shell and an HTTP + SSE API, supports multiple workspaces, and lets clients reconnect to active sessions. Start it in the foreground and open the Web Shell: ```bash qwen serve --open ``` The default address is `http://127.0.0.1:4170`. To run and manage it in the background instead: ```bash qwen daemon start qwen daemon status qwen daemon logs -f qwen daemon stop ``` By default, the daemon listens on loopback without bearer authentication; any local process that can reach it can use the full API, including code execution. On shared or untrusted hosts, set `QWEN_SERVER_TOKEN` and use `--require-auth`. See the [Daemon guide](./docs/users/qwen-serve.md) for workspaces, authentication, remote access, and the API. ## Capabilities Qwen Code ships with a complete agent harness — multi-agent orchestration, persistent memory, and deep extensibility, all built in. ### Agentic core - **[SubAgents](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/features/sub-agents/)** — delegate focused subtasks to specialized agents with their own context and toolsets, in the foreground or background. - **[Agent Teams](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/features/multi-agent-coordination/)** _(experimental)_ — a leader coordinates teammates that share a task list and exchange messages, with read-only investigators and an optional single worktree writer. - **[Agent Arena](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/features/arena/)** _(experimental)_ — run the same task on multiple models in isolated Git worktrees, compare solutions side by side, and merge the winner. - **[Dynamic Workflows](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/workflow-mode/)** _(opt-in)_ — the model writes JavaScript workflows that orchestrate agents: parallel fan-out, verification passes, and resumable runs. - **[Goals](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/features/goals/)** — `/goal` keeps the session working across turns until an independent verifier accepts the outcome, within a token budget. - **[Scheduled tasks](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/features/scheduled-tasks/)** — `/loop` and cron tools re-run prompts on an interval or at a set time. ### Memory, skills, and sessions - **[Auto-Memory](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/features/memory/)** — the agent writes its own notes and recalls them across sessions; your `QWEN.md` and `AGENTS.md` briefings load automatically. - **[Skills & Auto-Skills](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/features/skills/)** — built-in skills (`/review`, `/batch`, `/bugfix`…) work out of the box; `/learn` distills docs or code into new skills, the agent can generate skills on its own _(opt-in)_, and `/curator` maintains the library. - **[Session management](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/features/session-overview/)** — resume past conversations with `/resume`, and browse, rename, or archive sessions. ### Extensibility and control - **[Hooks](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/features/hooks/)** — run your own scripts at lifecycle events: before and after tool calls, session start and end, and more. - **[MCP](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/features/mcp/)** — connect any Model Context Protocol server to add tools, resources, and prompts. - **[LSP integration](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/features/lsp/)** _(experimental, opt-in)_ — native language-server support: go-to-definition, references, diagnostics, and code actions. - **[Computer Use & Browser Use](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/features/computer-use/)** — automate desktop applications and the browser through native MCP tools. - **[Plan Mode & approval modes](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/features/approval-mode/)** — plan read-only before touching files, then choose per-call confirmation, auto-edit, classifier-driven [Auto Mode](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/features/auto-mode/), or YOLO. - **[Sandbox](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/features/sandbox/) & [Git worktrees](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/features/worktree/)** — confine tool execution with built-in sandboxing and isolate wide-ranging edits in a temporary worktree. ### Open and multi-platform - **Open source, inside and out** — the framework and the Qwen models are open source and evolve together. - **[Multi-protocol](https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/configuration/model-providers/)** — OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Qwen APIs, plus any third-party provider or local model (Ollama / vLLM). Switch at runtime. - **Beyond the terminal** — IDE plugins, desktop app, Web UI, IM channels, headless mode, SDKs, and daemon mode. See [How to Use Qwen Code](#how-to-use-qwen-code). ## Qwen Code Evaluation On **SWE-bench Verified**, seven Qwen Code versions scored **76.40%–77.80%** on average using the same Qwen 3.7 Max model (500 tasks, three trials per version). ![Average SWE-bench Verified scores by Qwen Code version: 0.0.14, 77.80%; 0.1.0, 76.73%; 0.5.0, 76.60%; 0.10.0, 76.47%; 0.15.0, 77.67%; 0.19.0, 76.40%; 0.22.0, 77.33%.](./.github/assets/qwen-code-avg-score-trend.svg) [Full results and evaluation configuration →](./docs/evaluation.md) ## Ecosystem - [**Qwen Code Desktop**](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/releases/tag/desktop-latest) — Official desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux - [**AionUi**](https://github.com/iOfficeAI/AionUi) — A modern GUI for command-line AI tools including Qwen Code - [**Gemini CLI Desktop**](https://github.com/Piebald-AI/gemini-cli-desktop) — A cross-platform desktop/web/mobile UI for Qwen Code - [**qwen-audio-agent**](https://github.com/QwenAudio/qwen-audio-agent) — Realtime full-duplex voice frontend for Qwen Code over ACP — talk hands-free with barge-in and a local wake word - [**🦞 Qwen Code Claw**](https://github.com/openclaw/acpx) — Let other agents (Claude, Codex, etc.) delegate coding tasks to Qwen Code via ACP. Paste this prompt into your agent: ```text Use Qwen Code as a coding agent. First, fetch and read this skill reference: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/refs/heads/main/.qwen/skills/qwen-code-claw/SKILL.md Then follow the instructions inside to install, authenticate, and use Qwen Code via acpx for all coding tasks. ``` - [**Aliyun Model Studio CLI**](https://github.com/modelstudioai/cli) — Official CLI for Aliyun's AI platform (`bailian-cli`). Extends Qwen Code with image/video generation, knowledge retrieval, app orchestration, and model deployment ## Privacy See the [Terms of Service and Privacy Notice](./docs/users/support/tos-privacy.md), including [Chrome extension and Browser Use data handling](./docs/users/support/tos-privacy.md#chrome-extension-and-browser-use). ## Contributing Contributions are welcome! See [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidelines. ## Acknowledgments This project was originally based on [Google Gemini CLI](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli) v0.8.2. We gratefully acknowledge the Gemini CLI team's excellent work. Starting from Qwen Code v0.1, we stopped syncing with upstream and began independent development as a multi-protocol, multi-platform agent framework with deep integrations for Qwen models and beyond.
